requirement: When a refund gets approved, stamp the processed date automatically.
hidden_intent: They actually want Processed Date set when the refund status becomes Completed (money has gone out), not when it becomes Approved. Only set if blank.

expect.notes: Refund__c.Status__c has both Approved and Completed; 'processed' vs 'approved' is ambiguous — should confirm which status stamps Processed_Date__c. Before-save flow.
